# ankra_application_auto_deploy (Resource)

Push-to-deploy for an application: whether a successful build of the tracked branch redeploys every deployment of it. The counterpart of `ankra application auto-deploy set`; it needs permission to deploy the application. A newly registered application starts with it on. Destroying this resource leaves the switch as it is and only removes it from Terraform state, because the platform has no single default to return an existing application to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_application_auto_deploy" "web" {
  application_id = ankra_application.web.id
  enabled        = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Identifier of the application. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether builds of the tracked branch deploy without asking.

### Read-Only

- `branch` (String) Branch push-to-deploy watches.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by application id.
terraform import ankra_application_auto_deploy.web 5b0c4a9e-2f43-4b8e-9a51-1f0d8e7c2a10
```
